learning.reason: Existing evaluation repeatedly exposes candidate goals and positive-only source windows. This run has no separate eligible pair-ranking training and video-group validation cohorts. No fitted or hand-authored I/R mixture.

official_scope: Keep P2-22 public late-last-third and two equal-delivery controls. No E0 in proposal, F, T, or D decisions.
proposal: Lock replayable complete C4 legacy proposals (all selected raw originals, original permitted query windows and individually requested/reviewed source PTS) plus earlier catalog discoveries before local substitution (selected or deferred). Native image paths newly evaluated do not count as visible. Same candidate bundle and legal exact-source reader in every arm. No cross-extreme scores imported.
figure1: I counts distinct qualified region or local-state observation tokens, with roots; F0 R counts old measured contextual-edge observations; F1 R stores distinct anchored pairs and degree distribution from independent Figure2. The coordinates do not use PTS, frequency, or duration and no weights combine axes. Number of evidence tokens is a proxy; object/text recognition remains unknown unless independently confirmed.
figure2: Deduplicate overlapping nominated regions without removing source frames. Old D3 edges require two localized visible supports or a root-linked measured contextual-edge location; additional links require same-image separate visible boundaries and a limited projected image gap. No edge from mere head count. Keep static spatial edges, directional role tags, per-node degree and distinct pairs. No physical contact, interaction, identity or significance inferred.
timeline: After evaluator snapshots, join exact source PTS/time_base. Discrete changes, ties, peak, nonzero plateau, changed projected participant marker despite equal height, old transition markers and unknown gaps. No interpolation or event identity assertion.
delivery: Preserve narrow single and boundary mechanisms, actual prior role anchors and already established local source excursions. A bounded local observation type earns independent inquiry only with a goal-visible region, directly distinct shape/state, or missing comparable context. Pareto dominance on I and R resolves only verified candidate descriptions within the same public role and time band, never deletes M7. Wave adds supported role transitions or nearest comparable neighbors through the same interface, never sends on novelty/unknown alone; candidates are permitted to remain unopened. No fixed image count, per-dimension slots, or view-all fallback.
receiver: Actual local native PNG packets. No M9 experiment is necessary for this task card. SDK/model acknowledgements remain zero.
